html:
Question 15
?

Given that the tangent line approximation to the function f(x) at x=−1 underestimates the values of the function in the neighborhood of x=−1, which of the following must be true?

a
f(x) is concave down in the neighborhood of x=−1
b
f(x) is discontinous at x=−1
c
f(x) has a local maximum at x=−1
d
f(x) is a constant function
e
f(x) is concave up in the neighborhood of x=−1
